# Hernán De Souza (Erno)

> AI Engineer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina (UTC-3), looking for Forward Deployed Engineer roles. I turn business problems into LLM systems in production. Building software professionally since 2010. Works in English and Spanish.

## Who

Hernán De Souza, alias Erno. Current role: AI Engineer at MODO, a fintech in Argentina (since Jan 2026). Previously Senior Frontend Developer at MODO (Apr 2024 – Dec 2025). Freelance full-stack developer since Jan 2023.

## What I do

- LLM applications from prompt design to production APIs, using OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini APIs.
- Generative Engine Optimization for AI search surfaces, tracked with mention rate, citation share and traffic attribution.
- Internal AI tools that automate repetitive processes.
- Agent infrastructure for Claude Code and MCP, published as open source.

## Projects

- Firulapp (https://firulapp.com.ar): own product built end to end. Community app for pet owners in Buenos Aires with a social feed and an AI-assisted Lost & Found. 200+ pull requests shipped with Claude Code.
- LLM systems at a fintech: day job at MODO, described in generic terms.
- Prompteo (https://claudelingo-roan.vercel.app): own product. Duolingo-style learning app in Spanish that teaches small-business owners to use AI without programming; 141 lessons across 9 courses.
- 777 en serie (https://vamosalaire.app): website and live graphics engine for an urban streaming show from San Martín, Buenos Aires.
- Dermacare Studio (https://dermacare.ar): website plus client management and appointment system for an aesthetics studio in Buenos Aires. Next.js and Supabase.
- Edgar Hernán (https://edgar-hernan.vercel.app): press kit site for a cuarteto singer from Buenos Aires.
- Atlantis (https://github.com/soyerno/Atlantis): open-source orchestrator for Claude Code with parallel specialist agents, auditors and judges.
- Nexo Agent Server (https://github.com/soyerno/nexo-agent-server): durable MCP control plane for networks of AI orchestrators, with a one-command client (https://github.com/soyerno/nexo-agent-client).
- Claude Code skills marketplace (https://github.com/SoyErnoModo/erno-modo-marketplace): six skills and agents.
- nestjs-toon (https://github.com/soyerno/nestjs-toon): NestJS interceptor that serializes API responses to TOON to reduce LLM token usage.
- stripe-plans-importer-nodejs (https://github.com/soyerno/stripe-plans-importer-nodejs): bulk-import Stripe plans from a CSV.
- Tienda Rápida (https://tiendarapida.vercel.app): free self-hostable online store MVP.
- Solar34 (https://github.com/soyerno/solar34): solar proposal site for 34 rooftops in a Buenos Aires neighborhood.
